## Panel D: PTPRC cassette usage vs clone size

Prerequisite: the Supp Fig 4 data-loading chunk (`output_dir`) and the Panel B
chunk (`ptprc_umi`, `min_reads_per_umi`). Tests whether PTPRC cassette usage
tracks clone size, with the clone rather than the cell as the unit of analysis.
Cassette B is omitted because it is retained in essentially every molecule and
so carries no variance to associate with anything.

```{r}
set.seed(42)

# Per-cell lineage barcode for every cell in the dataset.
combined.dir  <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/combined/")
combined_data <- read.csv(paste0(combined.dir, "dataframes/GFP_invitro_all.csv"))

MIN_CLONE_INFORMATIVE <- 3      # below this a clone mean psi is unstable
SENSITIVITY_MINIMUMS  <- 2:6
N_SIZE_PERMUTATIONS   <- 2000
SIZE_CASSETTES        <- c(A = "PTPRC_exon4", C = "PTPRC_exon6")

# Clone size is the number of cells carrying the barcode in the whole dataset,
# not the number with PTPRC coverage: size is a property of the expansion,
# coverage is a property of the assay. Using informative cells as the size would
# make the x-axis partly an assay-depth axis.
clone_sizes <- combined_data %>%
  filter(barcode != "none") %>%
  count(barcode, name = "clone_size")

# Per-cell psi for one cassette, from the molecules informative for it: a
# molecule either spans the exon body or carries the N-gap that skips it.
cassette_psi <- function(exon) {
  ptprc_umi %>%
    filter(read_count >= min_reads_per_umi) %>%
    group_by(cellID, UMI) %>%
    summarise(inc = any(category == exon),
              exc = any(category == paste0(exon, "_exclusion")),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(inc | exc) %>%
    group_by(cellID) %>%
    summarise(n_umi = n(), psi = sum(inc) / n(), .groups = "drop")
}

# Per-cell psi on barcoded cells, with the cell's clone size attached.
cell_psi <- bind_rows(lapply(names(SIZE_CASSETTES), function(cassette) {
  cassette_psi(SIZE_CASSETTES[[cassette]]) %>%
    inner_join(combined_data %>% select(cellID, barcode), by = "cellID") %>%
    filter(barcode != "none") %>%
    inner_join(clone_sizes, by = "barcode") %>%
    mutate(cassette = cassette)
}))

# One row per clone. Cells within a clone are not independent, so every test
# below runs on clone means and treats the clone as the unit.
summarise_clones <- function(cells, min_informative) {
  cells %>%
    group_by(barcode) %>%
    summarise(clone_size    = first(clone_size),
              n_informative = n(),
              mean_psi      = mean(psi),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_informative >= min_informative)
}

# Per-cell psi piles up at 0 or 1, so a clone mean over few cells lands on that
# boundary more often than a mean over many. Larger clones contribute more
# informative cells, so clone size and clone mean psi correlate even when psi is
# dealt to cells at random (negative for a mostly-retained cassette, positive
# for a mostly-skipped one). A null that permutes clone size against clone means
# is centred on 0 and reads this as association. The null here shuffles per-cell
# psi across all barcoded cells: each clone keeps its informative-cell count and
# only the link between a cell's psi and its clone is broken. The p-value is
# two-sided around the null centre, and excess rho is observed minus null mean.
size_association <- function(cells, min_informative) {
  clones <- cells %>%
    group_by(barcode) %>%
    summarise(clone_size = first(clone_size), n_informative = n(),
              .groups = "drop")
  clone_index <- match(cells$barcode, clones$barcode)
  keep <- clones$n_informative >= min_informative
  clone_rho <- function(psi) {
    mean_psi <- rowsum(psi, clone_index, reorder = TRUE)[, 1] / clones$n_informative
    cor(clones$clone_size[keep], mean_psi[keep], method = "spearman")
  }
  rho <- clone_rho(cells$psi)
  null_rho <- replicate(N_SIZE_PERMUTATIONS, clone_rho(sample(cells$psi)))
  null_centre <- mean(null_rho)
  p <- (sum(abs(null_rho - null_centre) >= abs(rho - null_centre)) + 1) /
       (N_SIZE_PERMUTATIONS + 1)
  data.frame(min_informative = min_informative, n_clones = sum(keep),
             n_cells = sum(clones$n_informative[keep]),
             rho = rho, null_rho = null_centre,
             null_low  = quantile(null_rho, 0.025)[[1]],
             null_high = quantile(null_rho, 0.975)[[1]],
             excess_rho = rho - null_centre, p = p)
}

size_stats <- cell_psi %>%
  group_by(cassette) %>%
  group_modify(~ size_association(.x, MIN_CLONE_INFORMATIVE)) %>%
  ungroup()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(size_stats))) {
  row <- size_stats[i, ]
  cat(sprintf(paste0("cassette %s: %d clones (%d cells) | Spearman rho = %.3f | ",
                     "shuffled-psi null %.3f [%.3f, %.3f] | excess %.3f | perm p = %.4g\n"),
              row$cassette, row$n_clones, row$n_cells, row$rho, row$null_rho,
              row$null_low, row$null_high, row$excess_rho, row$p))
}

# The informative-cell minimum is a free choice, so the test is repeated across
# a range of minimums; an association that holds at only one is not robust.
size_sensitivity <- cell_psi %>%
  group_by(cassette) %>%
  group_modify(~ bind_rows(lapply(SENSITIVITY_MINIMUMS,
                                  function(m) size_association(.x, m)))) %>%
  ungroup()
cat("\nSensitivity to the per-clone informative-cell minimum:\n")
print(size_sensitivity %>%
        mutate(across(c(rho, null_rho, excess_rho), ~ round(.x, 3)),
               p = signif(p, 3)) %>%
        select(cassette, min_informative, n_clones, rho, null_rho, excess_rho, p),
      n = Inf)

# Clone-free read-out: per-cell psi by clone-size bin, singletons included.
cat("\nPer-cell psi by clone-size bin:\n")
print(cell_psi %>%
        mutate(size_bin = cut(clone_size, c(0, 1, 5, 20, 40, Inf),
                              labels = c("1", "2-5", "6-20", "21-40", ">40"))) %>%
        group_by(cassette, size_bin) %>%
        summarise(cells = n(), clones = n_distinct(barcode),
                  mean_psi = round(mean(psi), 3), .groups = "drop"),
      n = Inf)

# Both cassettes share one panel: their clone means sit in separate psi bands
# (A near its pooled 0.6, C near 0.1), so colour keeps them apart. The
# statistics stay per cassette because each has its own shuffled-psi null.
size_labels <- size_stats %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("cassette %s: rho = %.2f (null %.2f), p = %.3f",
                         cassette, rho, null_rho, p))
clone_psi_panel <- cell_psi %>%
  group_by(cassette) %>%
  group_modify(~ summarise_clones(.x, MIN_CLONE_INFORMATIVE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Styled after Fig 4K (translucent points, radius-scaled size).
p_size <- ggplot(clone_psi_panel,
                 aes(x = clone_size, y = mean_psi, color = cassette)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_informative), alpha = 0.45) +
  geom_smooth(aes(fill = cassette), method = "lm", se = TRUE,
              linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.15, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_radius(range = c(2, 11)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(A = "black", C = "#D55E00"),
                     labels = setNames(size_labels$label, size_labels$cassette)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(A = "black", C = "#D55E00")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "vertical", legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1), order = 1),
         size  = guide_legend(direction = "horizontal", order = 2)) +
  labs(x = "Clone size (cells, log scale)",
       y = "Clone mean psi (cassette retained)",
       color = NULL, size = "Informative cells",
       title = "PTPRC cassette usage vs clone size",
       subtitle = sprintf(paste0("Clones with >= %d informative cells\n",
                                 "null = per-cell psi shuffled across clones"),
                          MIN_CLONE_INFORMATIVE))
print(p_size)
ggsave(p_size, file = paste0(output_dir, "PanelD_PTPRC_psi_vs_clone_size.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 5.5, height = 6.8)
```


## Panel E: IL7R soluble (TM-out)

Prerequisite: run the Supp Fig 4 ## Data loading chunk

```{r}
set.seed(42)

N_DISPERSION_SIM <- 2000
DEPTH_CUT        <- 3      # a per-cell ratio is only measurable with several UMIs

# Per-cell IL7R isoform UMIs. out = TM skipped (soluble).
il7r_cells <- integrated %>%
  mutate(
    count_in_care  = IL7R_TM_in_CaRe,
    count_out_care = IL7R_TM_out_CaRe,
    count_in_brie  = IL7R_exon6_TM_in_BRIE,
    count_out_brie = IL7R_exon6_TM_out_BRIE,
    count_in       = count_in_care  + count_in_brie,
    count_out      = count_out_care + count_out_brie,
    count_total    = count_in + count_out
  ) %>%
  filter(count_total > 0)

# Power ceiling: a single-UMI cell is always 0% or 100% soluble by construction.
depth_levels <- c(1, 2, 3, 5, 10)
depth_table  <- sapply(depth_levels, function(d) sum(il7r_cells$count_total >= d))
names(depth_table) <- paste0(">=", depth_levels)
cat("Informative cells by IL7R UMI depth (Ca*Re + BRIE2):\n")
print(depth_table)

# --- Overdispersion test ------------------------------------------------------
# Null: every cell shares the pooled soluble fraction, so its TM-out count ~
# Binomial(depth, p). A soluble-biased subpopulation makes the observed per-cell
# counts more variable than this null. The statistic is the sum of squared
# Pearson residuals, compared against counts simulated under the null.
overdispersion_test <- function(count_out, count_total) {
  keep <- count_total > 0
  count_out <- count_out[keep]; count_total <- count_total[keep]
  p_out    <- sum(count_out) / sum(count_total)
  expected <- count_total * p_out
  var_null <- count_total * p_out * (1 - p_out)
  observed <- sum((count_out - expected)^2 / var_null)
  null <- replicate(N_DISPERSION_SIM,
                    sum((rbinom(length(count_total), count_total, p_out) - expected)^2 /
                        var_null))
  list(observed = observed, null = null, p_out = p_out, n_cells = length(count_total),
       p = (sum(null >= observed) + 1) / (N_DISPERSION_SIM + 1))
}

sources <- list(
  "Ca*Re"         = c("count_out_care", "count_in_care"),
  "Ca*Re + BRIE2" = c("count_out",      "count_in"),
  "BRIE2"         = c("count_out_brie", "count_in_brie"))
dispersion_results <- list()
cat("\nOverdispersion vs single-ratio binomial null:\n")
for (source in names(sources)) {
  out_col <- sources[[source]][1]; in_col <- sources[[source]][2]
  for (min_depth in c(1, DEPTH_CUT)) {
    total <- il7r_cells[[out_col]] + il7r_cells[[in_col]]
    d <- il7r_cells[total >= min_depth, ]
    result <- overdispersion_test(d[[out_col]], d[[out_col]] + d[[in_col]])
    dispersion_results[[paste(source, min_depth)]] <- result
    cat(sprintf("  %-14s depth >= %d: %4d cells | %3d soluble UMIs in %3d cells | soluble fraction %.4f | observed %.0f vs null mean %.0f | p = %.3g\n",
                source, min_depth, result$n_cells, sum(d[[out_col]]), sum(d[[out_col]] > 0),
                result$p_out, result$observed, mean(result$null), result$p))
  }
}
care_dispersion <- dispersion_results[["Ca*Re 1"]]

# --- Per-cell soluble enrichment (Ca*Re) --------------------------------------
# For each cell, P(>= observed TM-out UMIs | Binomial(depth, p)), one-sided,
# BH-corrected. Cells passing FDR < 0.05 carry more soluble signal than a
# single global ratio can explain
care_cells <- il7r_cells %>%
  filter(count_in_care + count_out_care > 0) %>%
  mutate(count_total_care = count_in_care + count_out_care,
         p_soluble = pbinom(count_out_care - 1, size = count_total_care,
                            prob = care_dispersion$p_out, lower.tail = FALSE),
         p_soluble_adj = p.adjust(p_soluble, method = "BH"))
n_soluble_cells <- sum(care_cells$p_soluble_adj < 0.05)
cat(sprintf("\nCa*Re cells with soluble enrichment beyond the global ratio (FDR < 0.05): %d of %d\n",
            n_soluble_cells, nrow(care_cells)))

# --- In-text numbers -----------------------------------------------------------
care_umis <- sum(il7r_cells$count_in_care + il7r_cells$count_out_care)
brie_umis <- sum(il7r_cells$count_in_brie + il7r_cells$count_out_brie)
cat(sprintf("\nSoluble molecules: Ca*Re %d / %d (%.1f%%) | TenX (BRIE2) %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(il7r_cells$count_out_care), care_umis,
            100 * sum(il7r_cells$count_out_care) / care_umis,
            sum(il7r_cells$count_out_brie), brie_umis,
            100 * sum(il7r_cells$count_out_brie) / brie_umis))

# Co-expression minimums
for (source in c("Ca*Re", "Ca*Re + BRIE2")) {
  out_col <- sources[[source]][1]; in_col <- sources[[source]][2]
  deep <- il7r_cells[il7r_cells[[out_col]] + il7r_cells[[in_col]] >= DEPTH_CUT, ]
  soluble_pos <- deep[[out_col]] > 0
  cat(sprintf("Soluble+ cells also membrane+ (%s, depth >= %d): %d / %d (%.0f%%) of %d cells\n",
              source, DEPTH_CUT, sum(soluble_pos & deep[[in_col]] > 0), sum(soluble_pos),
              100 * mean(deep[[in_col]][soluble_pos] > 0), nrow(deep)))
}
cat(sprintf("Soluble+ barcoded cells (clonal test ceiling): Ca*Re %d | Ca*Re + BRIE2 %d\n",
            sum(il7r_cells$count_out_care > 0 & il7r_cells$barcode != "none"),
            sum(il7r_cells$count_out > 0 & il7r_cells$barcode != "none")))

# --- Overdispersion null distribution (Ca*Re) -------------
null_df <- data.frame(value = care_dispersion$null)
p_dispersion <- ggplot(null_df, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 45, fill = "gray70", alpha = 0.6, color = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = care_dispersion$observed,
             color = "#D55E00", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Overdispersion (sum of squared Pearson residuals)",
       y = "Simulations",
       title = "IL7R soluble fraction vs binomial null (Ca*Re)",
       subtitle = sprintf("Orange dashed = observed; p = %.3f (%d cells)",
                          care_dispersion$p, care_dispersion$n_cells))
print(p_dispersion)
ggsave(p_dispersion, file = paste0(output_dir, "PanelE_IL7R_binomial_null.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 3.5)

# --- Beta-binomial dispersion -------------------------------------------------
# The binomial test above can only reject; it cannot say how much cell-to-cell
# heterogeneity the data still allow. The beta-binomial carries that as a free
# parameter: y_i ~ BetaBin(n_i, mu, rho), where mu is the pooled soluble
# fraction and rho the intraclass correlation, so a cell of depth n has its
# variance inflated (1 + (n - 1) * rho) over binomial. rho = 0 recovers the
# binomial exactly, so the interval around rho reports both whether the soluble
# fraction varies between cells and by how much.
#
# lchoose(n, y) is kept in the likelihood so the value is directly comparable
# with dbinom's, which the likelihood-ratio test below relies on.
N_POWER_SIM <- 200
POWER_RHO_GRID <- c(0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.08, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30)

neg_loglik_betabinom <- function(par, soluble, depth) {
  mu <- plogis(par[1]); rho <- plogis(par[2])
  alpha <- mu * (1 - rho) / rho; beta <- (1 - mu) * (1 - rho) / rho
  -sum(lchoose(depth, soluble) +
       lbeta(soluble + alpha, depth - soluble + beta) - lbeta(alpha, beta))
}
neg_loglik_binom <- function(soluble, depth) {
  -sum(dbinom(soluble, depth, sum(soluble) / sum(depth), log = TRUE))
}
fit_betabinom <- function(soluble, depth) {
  start <- c(qlogis(max(sum(soluble) / sum(depth), 1e-4)), qlogis(0.05))
  fit <- optim(start, neg_loglik_betabinom, soluble = soluble, depth = depth,
               method = "Nelder-Mead", control = list(reltol = 1e-12, maxit = 5000))
  list(mu = plogis(fit$par[1]), rho = plogis(fit$par[2]), neg_loglik = fit$value)
}
# Profile likelihood: mu re-maximised at each fixed rho. The cutoff is the
# one-sided chi-square(1) 90% point, which is the 95% bound for a parameter
# sitting on the rho = 0 boundary, so the interval agrees with the test below.
profile_ci_rho <- function(soluble, depth, fit) {
  cutoff <- fit$neg_loglik + qchisq(0.90, 1) / 2
  grid <- exp(seq(log(1e-6), log(0.95), length.out = 400))
  profile <- sapply(grid, function(rho)
    optimize(function(logit_mu)
      neg_loglik_betabinom(c(logit_mu, qlogis(rho)), soluble, depth),
      c(-12, 2))$objective)
  inside <- profile <= cutoff
  list(grid = grid, profile = profile, cutoff = cutoff,
       low  = if (!any(inside)) NA else if (inside[1]) 0 else min(grid[inside]),
       high = if (!any(inside)) NA else max(grid[inside]))
}
# rho = 0 is on the parameter boundary, so the null is a 50:50 chi-square(0) /
# chi-square(1) mixture rather than chi-square(1).
lrt_binom_vs_betabinom <- function(soluble, depth, fit) {
  statistic <- max(2 * (neg_loglik_binom(soluble, depth) - fit$neg_loglik), 0)
  list(statistic = statistic, p = 0.5 * pchisq(statistic, 1, lower.tail = FALSE))
}

betabinom_results <- list()
cat("\nBeta-binomial dispersion (rho = intraclass correlation, 95% profile CI):\n")
for (source in names(sources)) {
  out_col <- sources[[source]][1]; in_col <- sources[[source]][2]
  for (min_depth in c(1, DEPTH_CUT)) {
    depth_all <- il7r_cells[[out_col]] + il7r_cells[[in_col]]
    cells <- il7r_cells[depth_all >= min_depth, ]
    soluble <- cells[[out_col]]; depth <- cells[[out_col]] + cells[[in_col]]
    fit <- fit_betabinom(soluble, depth)
    ci  <- profile_ci_rho(soluble, depth, fit)
    test <- lrt_binom_vs_betabinom(soluble, depth, fit)
    betabinom_results[[paste(source, min_depth)]] <-
      c(fit, ci[c("low", "high")], test, list(source = source, min_depth = min_depth,
        n_cells = length(depth), n_informative = sum(depth >= 2), profile = ci))
    cat(sprintf(paste0("  %-14s depth >= %d: %4d cells (%4d with depth >= 2, the only ones ",
                       "informative for rho) | mu %.4f | rho %.4f [%.4f, %.4f] | LRT %5.1f p = %.3g\n"),
                source, min_depth, length(depth), sum(depth >= 2),
                fit$mu, fit$rho, ci$low, ci$high, test$statistic, test$p))
  }
}

# Colours follow the figure key: Ca*Re cyan, the 10X/BRIE2 arm the TenX navy, and
# the pooled arm grey because it is a combination rather than a method.
method_colors <- c("Ca*Re" = "#00AEEF", "Ca*Re + BRIE2" = "#808080", "BRIE2" = "#2B3990")

# --- Profile likelihood of rho, all three arms --------------------------------
# A curve rising steeply from rho = 0 bounds the dispersion; a curve whose
# minimum sits away from 0 is positive evidence of heterogeneity.
profile_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(sources), function(source) {
  res <- betabinom_results[[paste(source, 1)]]
  data.frame(source = source, rho = res$profile$grid,
             delta = 2 * (res$profile$profile - res$neg_loglik))
}))
profile_points <- bind_rows(lapply(names(sources), function(source) {
  res <- betabinom_results[[paste(source, 1)]]
  data.frame(source = source, rho = res$rho, delta = 0,
             label = sprintf("%s: rho = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", source, res$rho, res$low, res$high))
}))
p_profile <- ggplot(profile_df, aes(x = rho, y = delta, color = source)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = qchisq(0.90, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = profile_points, size = 2.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors,
                     labels = setNames(profile_points$label, profile_points$source)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.95)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 12)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.8, legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical", legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt")) +
  labs(x = "Dispersion rho (intraclass correlation)",
       y = "Profile deviance  2 x (NLL - min NLL)", color = NULL,
       title = "IL7R soluble fraction: beta-binomial dispersion",
       subtitle = paste0("rho = 0 is the binomial null\n",
                         "Dotted = chi-square(1) 90% cutoff (95% bound at the boundary)"))
ggsave(p_profile, file = paste0(output_dir, "PanelE_IL7R_betabinom_profile.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 6)

# --- Posterior predictive check, Ca*Re ----------------------------------------
# Which model reproduces the observed spread of per-cell soluble counts.
care_fit <- betabinom_results[["Ca*Re 1"]]
care_depth   <- il7r_cells$count_out_care + il7r_cells$count_in_care
care_soluble <- il7r_cells$count_out_care
care_keep    <- care_depth > 0
care_depth   <- care_depth[care_keep]; care_soluble <- care_soluble[care_keep]
max_soluble  <- max(care_soluble)
expected_counts <- function(draw) {
  tab <- table(factor(pmin(draw, max_soluble), levels = 0:max_soluble))
  as.numeric(tab)
}
alpha_hat <- care_fit$mu * (1 - care_fit$rho) / care_fit$rho
beta_hat  <- (1 - care_fit$mu) * (1 - care_fit$rho) / care_fit$rho
binom_expected <- rowMeans(replicate(N_DISPERSION_SIM,
  expected_counts(rbinom(length(care_depth), care_depth, care_fit$mu))))
bb_expected <- rowMeans(replicate(N_DISPERSION_SIM,
  expected_counts(rbinom(length(care_depth), care_depth,
                         rbeta(length(care_depth), alpha_hat, beta_hat)))))
ppc_df <- data.frame(soluble = 0:max_soluble,
                     Observed = expected_counts(care_soluble),
                     Binomial = binom_expected,
                     `Beta-binomial` = bb_expected, check.names = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_longer(-soluble, names_to = "series", values_to = "cells")
p_ppc <- ggplot(ppc_df %>% filter(series == "Observed"),
                aes(x = soluble, y = cells)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey75", width = 0.62) +
  geom_point(data = ppc_df %>% filter(series != "Observed"),
             aes(color = series), size = 2.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = cells), vjust = -1.4, size = 2.8, color = "grey25") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Binomial" = "#D55E00", "Beta-binomial" = "#0072B2")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:max_soluble) +
  scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.15))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.7, legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Soluble (TM-out) UMIs per cell", y = "Cells (log scale)", color = NULL,
       title = "Ca*Re: observed vs model-expected soluble counts",
       subtitle = sprintf("Grey bars = observed, %d cells\nPoints = mean of %d simulations",
                          length(care_depth), N_DISPERSION_SIM))
ggsave(p_ppc, file = paste0(output_dir, "PanelE_IL7R_betabinom_ppc.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 6, height = 4.6)

# --- Power: what dispersion this depth distribution could detect --------------
# The binomial test's failure to reject is only meaningful next to the rho it
# could have found. Simulated at the observed Ca*Re depths and pooled mu.
power_depth <- care_depth
power_mu    <- care_fit$mu
power_curve <- data.frame(rho = POWER_RHO_GRID, power = sapply(POWER_RHO_GRID, function(rho) {
  alpha <- power_mu * (1 - rho) / rho; beta <- (1 - power_mu) * (1 - rho) / rho
  mean(replicate(N_POWER_SIM, {
    simulated <- rbinom(length(power_depth), power_depth,
                        rbeta(length(power_depth), alpha, beta))
    fit <- fit_betabinom(simulated, power_depth)
    lrt_binom_vs_betabinom(simulated, power_depth, fit)$p < 0.05
  }))
}))
detectable <- power_curve$rho[power_curve$power >= 0.80]
cat(sprintf("\nSmallest rho detectable at >= 80%% power (Ca*Re depths, alpha 0.05): %s\n",
            if (length(detectable)) sprintf("%.2f", min(detectable)) else "> 0.30"))
print(power_curve)
p_power <- ggplot(power_curve, aes(x = rho, y = power)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = care_fit$high), linetype = "dashed", color = "#D55E00") +
  geom_line(color = "#00AEEF", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "#00AEEF", size = 2.4) +
  annotate("text", x = care_fit$high, y = 0.1, hjust = -0.08, size = 2.9, color = "#D55E00",
           label = sprintf("95%% upper bound on rho = %.3f", care_fit$high)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "True dispersion rho", y = "Power to reject the binomial null",
       title = "Power of the IL7R dispersion test (Ca*Re)",
       subtitle = sprintf("Observed depths, %d cells; %d simulations per point\nDotted = 80%% power",
                          length(power_depth), N_POWER_SIM))
ggsave(p_power, file = paste0(output_dir, "PanelE_IL7R_dispersion_power.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 5.5, height = 4.2)

# --- Panel E: the two methods side by side ------------------------------------
# The dispersion claim and the reason 10X cannot support it are one figure: the
# left plot is the per-cell quantity rho is estimated from, the right is rho
# itself. Ca*Re counts isoform UMIs per cell directly and so resolves
# intermediate soluble fractions; BRIE2 imputes each cell's ratio and returns
# near-binary calls, which saturates its dispersion estimate.
arm_colors <- c("Ca*Re" = "#00AEEF", "10X (BRIE2)" = "#2B3990")
arm_of <- c("Ca*Re" = "Ca*Re", "BRIE2" = "10X (BRIE2)")

fraction_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(arm = "Ca*Re",
             depth = il7r_cells$count_in_care + il7r_cells$count_out_care,
             soluble = il7r_cells$count_out_care),
  data.frame(arm = "10X (BRIE2)",
             depth = il7r_cells$count_in_brie + il7r_cells$count_out_brie,
             soluble = il7r_cells$count_out_brie)) %>%
  filter(depth > 0, soluble > 0) %>%
  mutate(fraction = soluble / depth,
         bin = cut(fraction, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), include.lowest = TRUE,
                   labels = c("0-0.2", "0.2-0.4", "0.4-0.6", "0.6-0.8", "0.8-1.0"))) %>%
  count(arm, bin, name = "cells") %>%
  group_by(arm) %>% mutate(share = cells / sum(cells), n_soluble = sum(cells)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(arm = factor(arm, levels = names(arm_colors)))
arm_labels <- fraction_df %>% distinct(arm, n_soluble) %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("%s (%d soluble+ cells)", arm, n_soluble))

p_fraction <- ggplot(fraction_df, aes(x = bin, y = share, fill = arm)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.68) +
  geom_text(aes(label = cells), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
            vjust = -0.45, size = 2.7, color = "grey25") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colors,
                    labels = setNames(arm_labels$label, arm_labels$arm)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.9, legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical", legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Per-cell soluble (TM-out) fraction", y = "Share of soluble+ cells",
       fill = NULL, title = "Per-cell isoform ratios",
       subtitle = "10X calls are near-binary; Ca*Re resolves intermediates")

profile_two <- bind_rows(lapply(names(arm_of), function(source) {
  res <- betabinom_results[[paste(source, 1)]]
  data.frame(arm = arm_of[[source]], rho = res$profile$grid,
             delta = 2 * (res$profile$profile - res$neg_loglik))
})) %>% mutate(arm = factor(arm, levels = names(arm_colors)))
profile_min <- bind_rows(lapply(names(arm_of), function(source) {
  res <- betabinom_results[[paste(source, 1)]]
  data.frame(arm = arm_of[[source]], rho = res$rho, delta = 0,
             label = sprintf("%s: rho = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
                             arm_of[[source]], res$rho, res$low, res$high))
})) %>% mutate(arm = factor(arm, levels = names(arm_colors)))

p_rho <- ggplot(profile_two, aes(x = rho, y = delta, color = arm)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = qchisq(0.90, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = profile_min, size = 2.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = arm_colors,
                     labels = setNames(profile_min$label, profile_min$arm)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.95)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 12)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 0.9, legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "vertical", legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt")) +
  labs(x = "Dispersion rho (intraclass correlation)",
       y = "Profile deviance", color = NULL,
       title = "Between-cell dispersion",
       subtitle = "rho = 0 is the binomial null; dotted = 95% bound")

p_panelE <- (p_fraction | p_rho) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "IL7R soluble isoform: between-cell dispersion by method",
    theme = ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")))
ggsave(p_panelE, file = paste0(output_dir, "PanelE_IL7R_soluble_dispersion.pdf"),
       device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 5.8)

integrated.dir <- paste0(data.root, "Figure4/joint/integrated/")
dir.create(integrated.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(care_cells %>% select(cellID, count_in_care, count_out_care, count_total_care,
```

Prerequisites: the Figure4 liver `## Extraction` chunks, which write
`integrated_all_with_BRIE.csv` and the integrated Seurat object.

Loads the liver data used by Panels F-J.

```{r}
df <- read.csv(paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/joint/integrated/integrated_all_with_BRIE.csv")) %>%
  mutate(genotype = factor(ifelse(grepl("^Normal_", cellID), "WT", "KO"),
                           levels = c("WT", "KO")))

seurat_obj <- readRDS(paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/Seurat/integrated/integrated.rds"))
seurat_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat_obj[["RNA"]])
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)

# splice- vs exon-targeting
care_informative <- function(d, gene_name) {
  pos <- d[[paste0(gene_name, "_CaRe")]] > 0
  exc_col <- paste0(gene_name, "_exclusion_CaRe")
  if (exc_col %in% names(d)) pos <- pos | d[[exc_col]] > 0
  pos
}
tenx_informative <- function(d, gene_name) {
  # Match the TenX arm to the Ca*Re strategy
  x <- d[[paste0(gene_name, "_in_BRIE")]]
  if (paste0(gene_name, "_exclusion_CaRe") %in% names(d)) {
    x <- x + d[[paste0(gene_name, "_out_BRIE")]]
  }
  x > 0
}
```

## Panel F: Ca*Re vs TenX, KO (all targets)

Prerequisites: the `## Liver data loading` chunk above.

Not restricted to hepatocytes, matching Fig 4L

```{r}
output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Supplemental/SuppFig4/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

exon_labels  <- c(Kras = "exon 5", Nf2 = "exon 15", Slk = "exon 13",
                  Lsm14b = "exon 5", Dgkd = "exon 29")
target_order <- c("Kras", "Nf2", "Slk", "Lsm14b", "Dgkd")

# Per-gene Ca*Re vs BRIE2(TenX) informative fraction in <gene>_TenX+ cells, per
# genotype, with Clopper-Pearson CIs and a paired McNemar Ca*Re-vs-TenX p-value.
compute_panel_data <- function(gene_name) {
  tenx_col <- paste0(gene_name, "_TenX")

  sc_frac <- df %>%
    filter(.data[[tenx_col]] > 0) %>%
    mutate(care_pos = care_informative(pick(everything()), gene_name),
           brie_pos = tenx_informative(pick(everything()), gene_name)) %>%
    group_by(genotype) %>%
    summarise(total = n(),
              `Ca*Re` = sum(care_pos),
              `TenX`   = sum(brie_pos),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(condition = genotype) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(`Ca*Re`, `TenX`),
                 names_to = "method", values_to = "n_detected") %>%
    mutate(value = n_detected / total) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(ci = list(binom.test(n_detected, total)$conf.int),
           ci_lower = ci[1], ci_upper = ci[2]) %>%
    ungroup() %>% select(-ci) %>%
    mutate(method    = factor(method, levels = c("TenX", "Ca*Re")),
           condition = factor(condition, levels = c("WT", "KO")))

  mcnemar_care_vs_tenx <- function(condition_name) {
    cells <- df %>% filter(.data[[tenx_col]] > 0, genotype == condition_name)
    if (nrow(cells) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    tbl <- table(factor(care_informative(cells, gene_name), c(FALSE, TRUE)),
                 factor(tenx_informative(cells, gene_name), c(FALSE, TRUE)))
    tryCatch(mcnemar.test(tbl)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }
  sig_data <- sc_frac %>% distinct(condition) %>% rowwise() %>%
    mutate(p_value = mcnemar_care_vs_tenx(as.character(condition)),
           sig = case_when(is.na(p_value)  ~ "n.s.",
                           p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                           p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
                           p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
                           TRUE            ~ "n.s.")) %>% ungroup()

  list(gene_name = gene_name, combined = sc_frac, sig_data = sig_data)
}

panel_data <- lapply(target_order, compute_panel_data)
names(panel_data) <- target_order


method_colors <- c("Ca*Re" = "#00AEEF", "TenX" = "#2B3990")

method_labels <- c(
  "TenX"  = "<span style='color:#2B3990'>**TenX**</span>",
  "Ca*Re" = "<span style='color:#00AEEF'>**Ca&#42;Re**</span>")

panel_one_genotype <- function(pd, target_genotype, y_global, y_ceiling,
                               show_axis = FALSE) {
  combined    <- pd$combined %>% filter(condition == target_genotype)
  brackets_df <- pd$sig_data %>% filter(condition == target_genotype) %>%
    mutate(x_left = 1, x_right = 2,
           y_bracket = y_global * 1.15,
           y_tick    = y_global * 0.03,
           y_label   = y_bracket + y_global * 0.04)

  ggplot(combined, aes(x = method, y = value, fill = method)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.62) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
                  width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = x_left, xend = x_right, y = y_bracket, yend = y_bracket),
                 linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = x_left, xend = x_left, y = y_bracket - y_tick, yend = y_bracket),
                 linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = brackets_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 aes(x = x_right, xend = x_right, y = y_bracket - y_tick, yend = y_bracket),
                 linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = brackets_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              aes(x = (x_left + x_right) / 2, y = y_label, label = sig), size = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = method_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = method_labels) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_ceiling),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(5),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    labs(x = NULL,
         y = if (show_axis) "P(exon recovery | gene+)" else NULL,
         title = sprintf("***%s***<br>%s", pd$gene_name, exon_labels[[pd$gene_name]]),
         fill = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title   = ggtext::element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, size = 13,
                                                  lineheight = 1.2),
          axis.text.x  = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 11),
          axis.text.y  = if (show_axis) element_text(size = 11) else element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = if (show_axis) element_line() else element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
          plot.margin  = margin(4, 5, 2, 2))
}

target_genotype <- "KO"
y_global <- max(unlist(lapply(panel_data, function(pd) {
  d <- pd$combined %>% filter(condition == target_genotype)
  c(d$value, d$ci_upper)
})), na.rm = TRUE)
y_ceiling <- y_global * 1.25

panel_plots <- Map(function(pd, first) {
  panel_one_genotype(pd, target_genotype, y_global, y_ceiling, show_axis = first)
}, panel_data, seq_along(panel_data) == 1)
panel_combo <- wrap_plots(panel_plots, nrow = 1)

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelF_alltargets_KO_barplots.pdf"),
       panel_combo, width = 10, height = 3.6)
print(panel_combo)
```

## Panel G: cells available to each method per event

Prerequisites: the Liver data-loading chunk, for `df` (with `<gene>_TenX`,
`<gene>_CaRe`, `<gene>_in_BRIE`, `<gene>_out_BRIE`) and for the
`care_informative` / `tenx_informative` helpers.

```{r supp4_panelG_method_coverage}
output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Supplemental/SuppFig4/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

exon_labels  <- c(Kras = "exon 5", Nf2 = "exon 15", Slk = "exon 13",
                  Lsm14b = "exon 5", Dgkd = "exon 29")
target_order <- c("Kras", "Nf2", "Slk", "Lsm14b", "Dgkd")

event_facet_labels <- setNames(
  sprintf("%s (%s)", target_order, exon_labels[target_order]), target_order)

# One row per target x genotype: expression level of the gene and how many
# cells each method can speak about.
event_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(target_order, function(target) {
  bind_rows(lapply(c("WT", "KO"), function(target_genotype) {
    expressing <- df %>%
      filter(.data[[paste0(target, "_TenX")]] > 0, genotype == target_genotype)
    if (nrow(expressing) == 0) return(NULL)
    gene_umis    <- expressing[[paste0(target, "_TenX")]]
    care_umis    <- expressing[[paste0(target, "_CaRe")]]
    care_pos     <- care_informative(expressing, target)
    brie_pos     <- tenx_informative(expressing, target)
    data.frame(
      gene               = target,
      genotype           = target_genotype,
      n_tenx_pos          = nrow(expressing),
      median_gene_umis   = median(gene_umis),
      mean_gene_umis     = mean(gene_umis),
      max_gene_umis      = max(gene_umis),
      n_care_pos         = sum(care_pos),
      care_fraction      = mean(care_pos),
      median_care_umis   = if (any(care_umis > 0)) median(care_umis[care_umis > 0]) else NA_real_,
      n_brie_informative = sum(brie_pos),
      brie_fraction      = mean(brie_pos))
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(gene     = factor(gene, levels = target_order),
         genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("WT", "KO")))

cat("Per-event expression level and informative cells per method (all <gene>_TenX > 0 cells):\n")
print(as.data.frame(event_summary), row.names = FALSE)

structural_zeros <- event_summary %>% filter(n_brie_informative == 0)
if (nrow(structural_zeros) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nEvents with no TenX-informative cell: %s\n",
              paste(sprintf("%s (%s)", structural_zeros$gene,
                            structural_zeros$genotype), collapse = ", ")))
}

# Series names are the assembled figure's legend, so the panel needs no
# relabelling; the subtitle carries the exact definition of each.
coverage_long <- event_summary %>%
  select(gene, genotype, `TenX total` = n_tenx_pos,
         `TenX` = n_brie_informative, `Ca*Re` = n_care_pos) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`TenX total`, `TenX`, `Ca*Re`),
               names_to = "cell_set", values_to = "n_cells") %>%
  mutate(cell_set = factor(cell_set, levels = c("TenX total", "TenX", "Ca*Re")))

cell_set_colors <- c("TenX total" = "#B3B3B3",
                     "TenX" = "#2B3990",
                     "Ca*Re" = "#00AEEF")

coverage_plot <- ggplot(coverage_long,
                        aes(x = genotype, y = n_cells, fill = cell_set)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_cells), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 2.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(gene = event_facet_labels)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_set_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cells",
       title = "Cells available to each method per event",
       subtitle = paste0("TenX total = <gene>_TenX > 0; TenX and Ca*Re = cells ",
                         "informative for the exon, inclusion only where the ",
                         "probe sits inside it (same series as Fig 4L)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelG_method_coverage_per_event.pdf"),
       coverage_plot, width = 14, height = 4.5)
print(coverage_plot)
```

### Plotting

Prerequisites: the `## Panels H-I: KO Ca*Re+ controls` chunk above.

```{r}
if (!"percent.mt" %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)) {
  seurat_obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_obj, pattern = "^mt-")
}

ko_kras_qc <- df %>%
  mutate(seurat_cellID = ifelse(cellID %in% colnames(seurat_obj),
                                cellID,
                                sub("^(Normal|Esrp2KO)_", "", cellID))) %>%
  filter(seurat_cellID %in% colnames(seurat_obj),
         as.character(cluster) %in% hepatocyte_clusters,
         genotype == "KO",
         Kras_TenX > 0) %>%
  mutate(cluster_id  = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = hepatocyte_clusters),
         care_status = factor(ifelse(Kras_CaRe > 0, "care_pos", "care_neg"),
                              levels = c("care_neg", "care_pos"))) %>%
  left_join(data.frame(seurat_cellID = colnames(seurat_obj),
                       nCount        = seurat_obj$nCount_RNA,
                       percent_mt    = seurat_obj$percent.mt),
            by = "seurat_cellID")

cat(sprintf("KO Kras+ hepatocytes: %d (%d Ca*Re+, %d Ca*Re-)\n",
            nrow(ko_kras_qc),
            sum(ko_kras_qc$care_status == "care_pos"),
            sum(ko_kras_qc$care_status == "care_neg")))

qc_metrics <- c(nCount     = "Total UMI per cell",
                Kras_TenX   = "Kras_TenX (UMI counts)",
                percent_mt = "% mitochondrial reads")

qc_stats <- bind_rows(lapply(names(qc_metrics), function(m) {
  data.frame(
    metric = m,
    label  = qc_metrics[[m]],
    c5_p   = wilcox.test(ko_kras_qc[[m]] ~ (ko_kras_qc$cluster_id == "5"))$p.value,
    care_p = wilcox.test(ko_kras_qc[[m]] ~ ko_kras_qc$care_status)$p.value
  )
})) %>%
  mutate(c5_p_adj   = p.adjust(c5_p,   method = "BH"),
         care_p_adj = p.adjust(care_p, method = "BH"))
print(qc_stats)

plot_by_cluster <- function(y_var, y_label, p_adj, log_y = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(ko_kras_qc,
              aes(x = cluster_id, y = .data[[y_var]],
                  fill = cluster_id == "5")) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#B2182B", `FALSE` = "#B3B3B3"),
                      guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Hepatocyte cluster", y = y_label,
         subtitle = sprintf("cluster 5 vs others: p (BH) = %.3f", p_adj)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
  if (log_y) p <- p + scale_y_log10()
  p
}

plot_by_carestatus <- function(y_var, y_label, p_adj, log_y = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot(ko_kras_qc,
              aes(x = care_status, y = .data[[y_var]], fill = care_status)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(care_neg = "#B3B3B3", care_pos = "#B2182B"),
                      guide = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label,
         subtitle = sprintf("Ca*Re+ vs Ca*Re-: p (BH) = %.3f", p_adj)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
  if (log_y) p <- p + scale_y_log10()
  p
}

c5_p   <- setNames(qc_stats$c5_p_adj,   qc_stats$metric)
care_p <- setNames(qc_stats$care_p_adj, qc_stats$metric)

p_top <- (plot_by_cluster("nCount",     "Total UMI per cell",
                          c5_p["nCount"], log_y = TRUE) |
          plot_by_cluster("Kras_TenX",   "Kras_TenX (UMI counts)",
                          c5_p["Kras_TenX"]) |
          plot_by_cluster("percent_mt", "% mitochondrial reads",
                          c5_p["percent_mt"]))

p_bot <- (plot_by_carestatus("nCount",     "Total UMI per cell",
                             care_p["nCount"], log_y = TRUE) |
          plot_by_carestatus("Kras_TenX",   "Kras_TenX (UMI counts)",
                             care_p["Kras_TenX"]) |
          plot_by_carestatus("percent_mt", "% mitochondrial reads",
                             care_p["percent_mt"]))

qc_combined <- p_top / p_bot +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title    = "KO bypass QC: cluster 5 (top) and Ca*Re+ status (bottom)",
    subtitle = sprintf("KO Kras+ hepatocytes (n = %d, %d Ca*Re+, %d Ca*Re-); BH-adjusted Wilcoxon",
                        nrow(ko_kras_qc),
                        sum(ko_kras_qc$care_status == "care_pos"),
                        sum(ko_kras_qc$care_status == "care_neg")))

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelHI_KO_QC_combined.pdf"),
       qc_combined, width = 13, height = 7)
print(qc_combined)
```

## Panel J: KO Ca*Re+ rate by hepatocyte cluster

Prerequisites: the `## Liver data loading` chunk above.

KO cluster 5 defining markers to find features of exon inclusion despite Esrp2 KO.

```{r}
output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Supplemental/SuppFig4/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

hepatocyte_clusters <- c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")

if (!exists("seurat_obj")) {
  seurat_obj <- readRDS(paste0(data.root, "Figure4/liver/singleCell/Seurat/integrated/integrated.rds"))
}
seurat_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat_obj[["RNA"]])
# Saved object's `data` layer is empty (counts-only); populate log-normalized data
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)

seurat_cells <- colnames(seurat_obj)

care_meta <- df %>%
  mutate(seurat_cellID = ifelse(cellID %in% seurat_cells,
                                cellID,
                                sub("^(Normal|Esrp2KO)_", "", cellID))) %>%
  filter(seurat_cellID %in% seurat_cells,
         as.character(cluster) %in% hepatocyte_clusters,
         Kras_TenX > 0) %>%
  mutate(care_status = ifelse(Kras_CaRe > 0, "care_pos", "care_neg"),
         genotype    = as.character(genotype)) %>%
  select(seurat_cellID, care_status, genotype)

print(table(genotype = care_meta$genotype, status = care_meta$care_status))

# Recover cluster + Kras_TenX from df
ko_meta <- care_meta %>%
  filter(genotype == "KO") %>%
  left_join(df %>%
              mutate(seurat_cellID = ifelse(cellID %in% colnames(seurat_obj),
                                            cellID,
                                            sub("^(Normal|Esrp2KO)_", "", cellID))) %>%
              select(seurat_cellID, cluster, Kras_TenX),
            by = "seurat_cellID") %>%
  mutate(cluster      = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = hepatocyte_clusters),
         care_pos     = care_status == "care_pos",
         is_c5        = cluster == "5",
         log_kras_tenx = log1p(Kras_TenX))

# Per-cluster summary
ko_cluster_summary <- ko_meta %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total    = n(),
    n_care_pos = sum(care_pos),
    rate       = n_care_pos / n_total,
    .groups    = "drop"
  )
print(ko_cluster_summary)
ko_overall_rate <- mean(ko_meta$care_pos)

# Omnibus Fisher's exact (descriptive)
ko_crosstab <- table(cluster = ko_meta$cluster, care_pos = ko_meta$care_pos)
print(ko_crosstab)
ko_fisher <- fisher.test(ko_crosstab, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
print(ko_fisher)

# Logistic regression: cluster 5 vs others, with and without Kras_TenX adjustment.
# Headline stat = cluster-5 effect after controlling for log1p(Kras_TenX).
glm_unadj     <- glm(care_pos ~ is_c5,                data = ko_meta, family = binomial)
glm_kras_only <- glm(care_pos ~ log_kras_tenx,         data = ko_meta, family = binomial)
glm_full      <- glm(care_pos ~ is_c5 + log_kras_tenx, data = ko_meta, family = binomial)

cat("\n--- Cluster 5 unadjusted ---\n");        print(summary(glm_unadj)$coefficients)
cat("\n--- Kras_TenX only ---\n");                print(summary(glm_kras_only)$coefficients)
cat("\n--- Cluster 5 + Kras_TenX (full) ---\n"); print(summary(glm_full)$coefficients)

lrt_c5 <- anova(glm_kras_only, glm_full, test = "Chisq")
cat("\n--- LRT: cluster 5 indicator on top of Kras_TenX ---\n"); print(lrt_c5)

c5_coef <- summary(glm_full)$coefficients["is_c5TRUE", ]
c5_beta <- c5_coef["Estimate"]
c5_p    <- c5_coef["Pr(>|z|)"]
c5_or   <- exp(c5_beta)
lrt_p   <- lrt_c5$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]

ko_cluster_plot <- ggplot(ko_cluster_summary,
                          aes(x = cluster, y = rate, fill = cluster == "5")) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#B2182B", `FALSE` = "#4D4D4D"),
                    guide = "none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ko_overall_rate, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d/%d", n_care_pos, n_total)),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "Hepatocyte cluster",
       y = "P(Kras Ca*Re+ | Kras TenX+)",
       title = "KO Ca*Re+ rate by hepatocyte cluster",
       subtitle = sprintf(
         "Cluster 5 vs others (logistic, log1p Kras_TenX-adjusted): OR = %.1f, p = %.3f; LRT p = %.3f; dashed = overall %.3f (%d/%d)",
         c5_or, c5_p, lrt_p, ko_overall_rate,
         sum(ko_cluster_summary$n_care_pos),
         sum(ko_cluster_summary$n_total))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "PanelJ_KO_care_rate_per_cluster.pdf"),
       ko_cluster_plot, width = 7, height = 5)
print(ko_cluster_plot)
```

## Side analysis: Esrp2 knockout at the transcript level

Prerequisites: the Liver data-loading chunk (`df` and a log-normalized
`seurat_obj`).

Establishes that the Esrp2 germline knockout removes the Esrp2 transcript, which
is what the residual-inclusion argument for cluster 5 rests on. If Esrp2 message
survived in KO cluster 5, the exon inclusion scored there would be ordinary Esrp2
activity rather than anything needing a compensation account.

Detection of a sparse transcript falls with library size, so the knockout is
scored against background genes matched on WT detection rate: if Esrp2 collapses
in the KO while detection-matched genes hold, the loss is the allele rather than
a difference in depth or capture between the two samples.

This is a transcript measurement and cannot speak to protein. A knockout clean at
the message level is consistent with residual ESRP2 protein, with another factor
substituting, or with an Esrp2-independent route to inclusion, and nothing here
separates those; ESRP2 immunostaining or the allele design would.

```{r supp4_side_esrp2_knockout}
output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Supplemental/SuppFig4/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

hepatocyte_clusters <- c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")
N_MATCHED_CONTROLS <- 50
DETECTION_TOLERANCE <- 0.02
set.seed(42)

expression_data <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
counts_data     <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

knockout_cells <- df %>%
  mutate(seurat_cellID = ifelse(cellID %in% colnames(seurat_obj), cellID,
                                sub("^(Normal|Esrp2KO)_", "", cellID))) %>%
  filter(seurat_cellID %in% colnames(seurat_obj),
         as.character(cluster) %in% hepatocyte_clusters) %>%
  mutate(cluster     = factor(as.character(cluster), levels = hepatocyte_clusters),
         esrp2       = expression_data["Esrp2", seurat_cellID],
         esrp2_umis  = counts_data["Esrp2", seurat_cellID],
         esrp2_pos   = esrp2 > 0)

cat("Esrp2 in hepatocytes, by genotype:\n")
genotype_summary <- knockout_cells %>% group_by(genotype) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), n_esrp2_pos = sum(esrp2_pos),
            pct_esrp2_pos = 100 * mean(esrp2_pos),
            mean_lognorm = mean(esrp2), total_esrp2_umis = sum(esrp2_umis),
            .groups = "drop")
print(as.data.frame(genotype_summary), row.names = FALSE)

genotype_table <- table(factor(knockout_cells$genotype, c("WT", "KO")),
                        factor(knockout_cells$esrp2_pos, c(FALSE, TRUE)))
knockout_fisher <- fisher.test(genotype_table)
cat(sprintf("\nWT vs KO Esrp2 detection: Fisher p = %.3g, odds ratio = %.1f\n",
            knockout_fisher$p.value, unname(knockout_fisher$estimate)))

cat("\nEsrp2 detection per hepatocyte cluster and genotype:\n")
cluster_summary <- knockout_cells %>% group_by(cluster, genotype) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), n_esrp2_pos = sum(esrp2_pos),
            pct_esrp2_pos = 100 * mean(esrp2_pos), .groups = "drop")
print(as.data.frame(cluster_summary), row.names = FALSE)

# The cluster the compensation argument is about: any Esrp2 message left there
# would make the residual inclusion unremarkable.
cluster5_knockout <- knockout_cells %>% filter(genotype == "KO", cluster == "5")
cat(sprintf("\nKO cluster 5: %d cells, %d with any Esrp2 UMI, %d Esrp2 UMIs in total\n",
            nrow(cluster5_knockout), sum(cluster5_knockout$esrp2_pos),
            sum(cluster5_knockout$esrp2_umis)))

# Any residual KO signal is listed rather than summarised: single-UMI calls in a
# knockout are what ambient contamination looks like.
residual <- knockout_cells %>% filter(genotype == "KO", esrp2_umis > 0)
if (nrow(residual) > 0) {
  cat("\nKO cells carrying an Esrp2 UMI:\n")
  print(residual %>% select(cellID, cluster, esrp2_umis) %>% as.data.frame(),
        row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("\nNo KO hepatocyte carries a single Esrp2 UMI.\n")
}

# Detection-rate-matched background: genes whose WT detection rate sits within
# DETECTION_TOLERANCE of Esrp2's, scored for the same WT-to-KO change.
wt_cell_ids <- knockout_cells$seurat_cellID[knockout_cells$genotype == "WT"]
ko_cell_ids <- knockout_cells$seurat_cellID[knockout_cells$genotype == "KO"]
wt_detection <- Matrix::rowMeans(expression_data[, wt_cell_ids] > 0)
ko_detection <- Matrix::rowMeans(expression_data[, ko_cell_ids] > 0)

esrp2_wt_rate <- wt_detection[["Esrp2"]]
matched_pool <- setdiff(
  names(wt_detection)[abs(wt_detection - esrp2_wt_rate) < DETECTION_TOLERANCE],
  "Esrp2")
matched_genes <- sample(matched_pool, min(N_MATCHED_CONTROLS, length(matched_pool)))

matched_change <- data.frame(
  gene = matched_genes,
  wt_pct = 100 * wt_detection[matched_genes],
  ko_pct = 100 * ko_detection[matched_genes]) %>%
  mutate(retained = ko_pct / wt_pct)

cat(sprintf("\nEsrp2 WT detection %.1f%% -> KO %.1f%% (retains %.3f of its WT rate)\n",
            100 * esrp2_wt_rate, 100 * ko_detection[["Esrp2"]],
            ko_detection[["Esrp2"]] / esrp2_wt_rate))
cat(sprintf("%d detection-matched genes (WT rate within %.0f%%): median retained %.3f, 5th percentile %.3f\n",
            length(matched_genes), 100 * DETECTION_TOLERANCE,
            median(matched_change$retained),
            quantile(matched_change$retained, 0.05)))
cat(sprintf("Matched genes retaining as little as Esrp2 does: %d of %d\n",
            sum(matched_change$retained <= ko_detection[["Esrp2"]] / esrp2_wt_rate),
            nrow(matched_change)))

genotype_colors <- c(WT = "#C49A6C", KO = "#603913")

knockout_plot <- ggplot(cluster_summary,
                        aes(x = cluster, y = pct_esrp2_pos, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d/%d", n_esrp2_pos, n_cells)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genotype_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "Hepatocyte cluster", y = "Esrp2-detected cells (%)",
       title = "Esrp2 detection per hepatocyte cluster, WT vs KO",
       subtitle = "Fisher's exact on pooled hepatocytes; counts are Esrp2+/total") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "SideAnalysis_Esrp2_knockout_per_cluster.pdf"),
       knockout_plot, width = 7, height = 4.5)
print(knockout_plot)

matched_plot <- ggplot(matched_change, aes(x = wt_pct, y = ko_pct)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(color = "#B3B3B3", size = 1.8) +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(wt_pct = 100 * esrp2_wt_rate,
                               ko_pct = 100 * ko_detection[["Esrp2"]]),
             color = "#B2182B", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 100 * esrp2_wt_rate, y = 100 * ko_detection[["Esrp2"]],
           label = "Esrp2", hjust = -0.25, size = 3, fontface = "italic",
           color = "#B2182B") +
  labs(x = "WT detection (% of hepatocytes)",
       y = "KO detection (% of hepatocytes)",
       title = "Esrp2 against detection-matched genes",
       subtitle = sprintf(paste0("%d genes with WT detection within %.0f%% of ",
                                 "Esrp2; dashed line is no change"),
                          length(matched_genes), 100 * DETECTION_TOLERANCE)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "SideAnalysis_Esrp2_vs_matched_genes.pdf"),
       matched_plot, width = 5.5, height = 5)
print(matched_plot)
```


## Side analysis: Esrp2 level in Ca*Re+ vs Ca*Re- cells

Prerequisites: the Liver data-loading chunk (`df` and a log-normalized
`seurat_obj`).

Specificity control for Fig 4L and Supp Fig 4F. Ca\*Re detects the included exon
in a minority of cells that express each target, and one reading of that is a
dosage effect: the cells scored Ca\*Re+ are simply the ones carrying more Esrp2.
This asks whether Esrp2 itself differs between Ca\*Re+ and Ca\*Re- cells among WT
hepatocytes expressing each target.

WT only, because Esrp2 is not detected in KO cells at all, which the chunk
reports rather than assumes. Hepatocytes only (clusters 1-6), matching every
other Esrp2-effect panel.

Esrp2 is a sparsely detected transcript, so an unqualified null here would be
uninterpretable. Three things are reported together: the Wilcoxon test on
log-normalized Esrp2, the Fisher test on Esrp2 detection, and the odds ratio
that the observed group sizes and baseline detection rate give 80% power to
find. A null is only informative against that last number.

```{r supp4_side_esrp2_dosage}
output.dir <- paste0(plot.root, "Supplemental/SuppFig4/")
dir.create(output.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

hepatocyte_clusters <- c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6")
target_order <- c("Kras", "Nf2", "Slk", "Lsm14b", "Dgkd")
POWER_TARGET <- 0.80
POWER_ALPHA  <- 0.05

esrp2_lognorm <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")["Esrp2", ]
cell_depth    <- seurat_obj$nCount_RNA

liver_cells <- df %>%
  mutate(seurat_cellID = ifelse(cellID %in% colnames(seurat_obj), cellID,
                                sub("^(Normal|Esrp2KO)_", "", cellID))) %>%
  filter(seurat_cellID %in% colnames(seurat_obj),
         as.character(cluster) %in% hepatocyte_clusters) %>%
  mutate(esrp2      = esrp2_lognorm[seurat_cellID],
         nCount     = cell_depth[seurat_cellID],
         esrp2_pos  = esrp2 > 0)

# Esrp2 is absent from the KO by construction; stating it is what licenses the
# WT-only restriction below.
cat("Esrp2 detection rate in hepatocytes, by genotype:\n")
print(liver_cells %>% group_by(genotype) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), n_esrp2_pos = sum(esrp2_pos),
                  pct_esrp2_pos = 100 * mean(esrp2_pos), .groups = "drop") %>%
        as.data.frame(), row.names = FALSE)

wt_cells <- liver_cells %>% filter(genotype == "WT")

# Smallest odds ratio the group sizes and baseline rate can resolve, by search
# over the normal-approximation two-proportion power function.
detectable_odds_ratio <- function(n_pos, n_neg, baseline) {
  if (n_pos < 2 || n_neg < 2 || baseline <= 0 || baseline >= 1) return(NA_real_)
  power_at <- function(odds_ratio) {
    odds <- baseline / (1 - baseline) * odds_ratio
    p1   <- odds / (1 + odds)
    pooled <- (p1 * n_pos + baseline * n_neg) / (n_pos + n_neg)
    se_null <- sqrt(pooled * (1 - pooled) * (1 / n_pos + 1 / n_neg))
    se_alt  <- sqrt(p1 * (1 - p1) / n_pos + baseline * (1 - baseline) / n_neg)
    if (se_alt == 0) return(NA_real_)
    pnorm((abs(p1 - baseline) - qnorm(1 - POWER_ALPHA / 2) * se_null) / se_alt)
  }
  grid <- seq(1.05, 50, by = 0.05)
  reached <- which(vapply(grid, power_at, numeric(1)) >= POWER_TARGET)
  if (!length(reached)) NA_real_ else grid[reached[1]]
}

esrp2_by_target <- bind_rows(lapply(target_order, function(target) {
  expressing <- wt_cells %>% filter(.data[[paste0(target, "_TenX")]] > 0) %>%
    mutate(care_pos = .data[[paste0(target, "_CaRe")]] > 0)
  n_pos <- sum(expressing$care_pos); n_neg <- sum(!expressing$care_pos)
  if (n_pos < 2 || n_neg < 2) return(NULL)

  detection_table <- table(factor(expressing$care_pos, c(FALSE, TRUE)),
                           factor(expressing$esrp2_pos, c(FALSE, TRUE)))
  fisher_result <- fisher.test(detection_table)

  data.frame(
    gene            = target,
    n_care_pos      = n_pos,
    n_care_neg      = n_neg,
    pct_esrp2_care_pos = 100 * mean(expressing$esrp2_pos[expressing$care_pos]),
    pct_esrp2_care_neg = 100 * mean(expressing$esrp2_pos[!expressing$care_pos]),
    mean_esrp2_care_pos = mean(expressing$esrp2[expressing$care_pos]),
    mean_esrp2_care_neg = mean(expressing$esrp2[!expressing$care_pos]),
    wilcox_p        = wilcox.test(esrp2 ~ care_pos, data = expressing)$p.value,
    fisher_or       = unname(fisher_result$estimate),
    fisher_p        = fisher_result$p.value,
    detectable_or   = detectable_odds_ratio(n_pos, n_neg,
                                            mean(expressing$esrp2_pos[!expressing$care_pos])))
})) %>%
  mutate(wilcox_p_adj = p.adjust(wilcox_p, "BH"),
         fisher_p_adj = p.adjust(fisher_p, "BH"))

cat("\nEsrp2 in Ca*Re+ vs Ca*Re- cells, WT hepatocytes expressing each target:\n")
print(as.data.frame(esrp2_by_target), row.names = FALSE)

# Pooling cells on "Ca*Re+ for any target" is not a matched comparison: a cell
# expressing three targets has three chances to be called, so that grouping
# enriches the Ca*Re+ arm for multi-target cells and, with them, for depth. The
# imbalance is measured first, then the comparison is redone with one row per
# (cell, target), where each row is scored on the target it belongs to and every
# row carries exactly one chance of a call.
POOLED_TARGETS <- c("Kras", "Nf2", "Slk")

pooled_cells <- wt_cells %>%
  mutate(n_targets_expressed = (Kras_TenX > 0) + (Nf2_TenX > 0) + (Slk_TenX > 0),
         any_care_pos = (Kras_CaRe > 0) | (Nf2_CaRe > 0) | (Slk_CaRe > 0)) %>%
  filter(n_targets_expressed > 0)

cat(sprintf("\nPooled (Kras/Nf2/Slk): %d Ca*Re+ and %d Ca*Re- WT hepatocytes\n",
            sum(pooled_cells$any_care_pos), sum(!pooled_cells$any_care_pos)))
cat(sprintf("Targets expressed per cell: Ca*Re+ %.2f vs Ca*Re- %.2f (Wilcoxon p = %.3g)\n",
            mean(pooled_cells$n_targets_expressed[pooled_cells$any_care_pos]),
            mean(pooled_cells$n_targets_expressed[!pooled_cells$any_care_pos]),
            wilcox.test(n_targets_expressed ~ any_care_pos,
                        data = pooled_cells)$p.value))
cat(sprintf("Median nCount: Ca*Re+ %.0f vs Ca*Re- %.0f (Wilcoxon p = %.3g)\n",
            median(pooled_cells$nCount[pooled_cells$any_care_pos]),
            median(pooled_cells$nCount[!pooled_cells$any_care_pos]),
            wilcox.test(nCount ~ any_care_pos, data = pooled_cells)$p.value))

target_rows <- bind_rows(lapply(POOLED_TARGETS, function(target) {
  pooled_cells %>%
    filter(.data[[paste0(target, "_TenX")]] > 0) %>%
    transmute(cellID, target,
              care_pos  = .data[[paste0(target, "_CaRe")]] > 0,
              gene_umis = .data[[paste0(target, "_TenX")]],
              esrp2, esrp2_pos, nCount)
})) %>% mutate(target = factor(target, levels = POOLED_TARGETS))

cat(sprintf("\nMatched comparison: %d (cell, target) rows from %d cells\n",
            nrow(target_rows), dplyr::n_distinct(target_rows$cellID)))
print(as.data.frame(target_rows %>% group_by(care_pos) %>%
        summarise(rows = n(), n_esrp2_pos = sum(esrp2_pos),
                  pct_esrp2_pos = 100 * mean(esrp2_pos),
                  mean_esrp2 = mean(esrp2), .groups = "drop")), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Fisher on Esrp2 detection: p = %.3g\n",
            fisher.test(table(target_rows$care_pos,
                              target_rows$esrp2_pos))$p.value))
cat(sprintf("Wilcoxon on log-normalized Esrp2: p = %.3g\n",
            wilcox.test(esrp2 ~ care_pos, data = target_rows)$p.value))

# Depth drives Esrp2 detection on its own, and each target is modelled with its
# own intercept so that a row is only compared against rows for the same gene.
depth_model <- glm(esrp2_pos ~ care_pos + target + log1p(nCount),
                   data = target_rows, family = binomial)
cat("\nEsrp2 detection adjusted for target identity and sequencing depth:\n")
print(summary(depth_model)$coefficients)

# Cells expressing more than one target contribute more than one row, so the
# tests above treat slightly fewer independent units than their n suggests.
cat(sprintf("\nRows from cells contributing more than one: %d of %d\n",
            sum(table(target_rows$cellID)[table(target_rows$cellID) > 1]),
            nrow(target_rows)))

care_colors <- c(`Ca*Re-` = "#B3B3B3", `Ca*Re+` = "#00AEEF")

detection_long <- esrp2_by_target %>%
  select(gene, `Ca*Re+` = pct_esrp2_care_pos, `Ca*Re-` = pct_esrp2_care_neg,
         n_care_pos, n_care_neg) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`Ca*Re+`, `Ca*Re-`), names_to = "care_status",
               values_to = "pct_esrp2") %>%
  mutate(n_cells = ifelse(care_status == "Ca*Re+", n_care_pos, n_care_neg),
         gene = factor(gene, levels = target_order),
         care_status = factor(care_status, levels = names(care_colors)))

detection_plot <- ggplot(detection_long,
                         aes(x = gene, y = pct_esrp2, fill = care_status)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75,
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_cells), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 2.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = care_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "Ca*Re target", y = "Esrp2-detected cells (%)",
       title = "Esrp2 detection in Ca*Re+ vs Ca*Re- cells",
       subtitle = paste0("WT hepatocytes expressing each target; Fisher's exact ",
                         "per gene; number above each bar is cells")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "SideAnalysis_Esrp2_detection_by_CaRe.pdf"),
       detection_plot, width = 7, height = 4.5)
print(detection_plot)

expression_long <- bind_rows(lapply(target_order, function(target) {
  wt_cells %>% filter(.data[[paste0(target, "_TenX")]] > 0) %>%
    transmute(gene = target,
              care_status = ifelse(.data[[paste0(target, "_CaRe")]] > 0,
                                   "Ca*Re+", "Ca*Re-"),
              esrp2 = esrp2)
})) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = target_order),
         care_status = factor(care_status, levels = names(care_colors)))

expression_plot <- ggplot(expression_long,
                          aes(x = care_status, y = esrp2, fill = care_status)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = care_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Esrp2 (log-normalized)",
       title = "Esrp2 expression in Ca*Re+ vs Ca*Re- cells",
       subtitle = "WT hepatocytes expressing each target; Wilcoxon rank-sum per gene") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))

ggsave(paste0(output.dir, "SideAnalysis_Esrp2_expression_by_CaRe.pdf"),
       expression_plot, width = 12, height = 4)
print(expression_plot)
```
